other_errors.critic_note: The screening review at [100] warned that this matter and another were drafts and risked including non-executed agreements; the agent then moved it to a draft-only list.

divergence: All fail, each on the precision criterion; T1 failed only there. All runs found most of the fifteen matters through path searches and scans of agreement files. They differ on the edges: T0 and T2 each left one needed matter unopened (its file name surfaced but scans and name filters did not carry it to the reads), T2 also excluded a needed draft agreement after a review warned about drafts, and all three listed matters outside the set (a draft-only merger in all, plus a capital-call matter's equity purchase agreement in T0 and T1 and another draft in T1). Reviews named the draft-only matter in T0 and T2 and the agents only moved it to a draft row.
